blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Volume / Story

blocks.source: クリアまで５０時間程度。本編よりはさすがに短いけれど、相変わらずの大作。
blocks.translation: It takes around 50 hours to clear. Naturally, it is shorter than the main game, but it is still a large-scale title.

blocks.source: 完全な続編なので、ペルソナ５本編をクリアしていることが前提。
blocks.translation: Since this is a complete sequel, it assumes that you have cleared Persona 5 proper.

blocks.source: ペルソナ５には改良版の『ザ・ロイヤル』もあるけれど、そちらのストーリーには接続していない模様。無印だけのプレイで問題ない。
blocks.translation: Persona 5 also has an enhanced version, Persona 5 Royal, but it seems this game's story does not connect to that version. Playing only the original is fine.

blocks.source: 物語の題材にＡＩを使うなど、ペルソナらしい今時さ。
blocks.translation: Using AI as the subject of the story is very Persona-like and up-to-date.

blocks.source: アクション化したとはいえ、ストーリー面はかなりしっかりしている。いつものペルソナと同等のクオリティと言ってもよいと思う。
blocks.translation: Although it has been turned into an action game, the story is quite solid. I think it is fair to say that it is of the same quality as a typical Persona game.

blocks.source: なお、本編での仲間達は序盤からすぐに加入する。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, the companions from the main game join almost immediately at the beginning.

blocks.source: 仕方ないことではあるが、一人ずつ仲間の掘り下げを行った本編ほどの印象は得られないかも。
blocks.translation: It is understandable, but you may not get quite the same impression as from the main game, which explored each companion individually.

blocks.source: とはいえ、杏、春、祐介のような本編では余りスポットライトが当たらなかったキャラにも、丁寧に出番とセリフを割り振っている。
blocks.translation: That said, even characters who did not receive much of the spotlight in the main game, such as Ann, Haru, and Yusuke, are carefully given their share of appearances and dialogue.

blocks.source: また、新規キャラ二名についてはしっかりと魅力的に描けているのは、さすがといったところ。
blocks.translation: The two new characters are also portrayed in a thoroughly appealing way, which is to be expected.

blocks.source: 終盤の展開は若干の既視感があるかも。
blocks.translation: The developments toward the end may feel somewhat familiar.

blocks.source: 本編からテーマを一貫しているため、そうなるのも仕方ないところではあるのだけど……。
blocks.translation: The themes have remained consistent with the main game, so I suppose that outcome is understandable...

blocks.source: おっさんもいるよ！
blocks.translation: There is an old guy, too!

blocks.source: ロン毛の胡散臭いおっさん刑事ということで、Ｐ２罰のパオフゥを思い出しました。
blocks.translation: The long-haired, shady old-guy detective reminded me of Baofu from P2: Eternal Punishment.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 全体の構成としては、長いイベントと長いダンジョンという相変わらずの組み合わせになっている。
blocks.translation: In terms of overall structure, it retains the same combination as before: long events and long dungeons.

blocks.source: ただし、本編のような日数制限はない。ストーリー進行に応じて、日付が進んでいく仕様になっている。コープ（好感度）などの要素はないし、本編にあったような恋愛要素もほぼなし。
blocks.translation: However, there is no day limit like in the main game. The date advances according to story progression. There are no elements such as Confidants (affection levels), and there is almost no romance element like there was in the main game.

blocks.source: 結果として、取り返しのつかない要素はほとんどなくなった。単調になったと言えなくもないけれど、気楽にゲーム面に集中できるので個人的には好ましく思えた。
blocks.translation: As a result, most irreversible elements have been eliminated. You could say it has become more monotonous, but I personally liked being able to comfortably focus on the gameplay.

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: 本編から一変してアクション戦闘に。
blocks.translation: Unlike the main game, the battle system has been completely transformed into action combat.

blocks.source: ぞろぞろ現れる敵をバッサバッサと斬り捨てていく。
blocks.translation: You cut down hordes of enemies as they come swarming in.

blocks.source: 操作キャラの変更も可能で、個性豊かな仲間達を自由に扱うことができる。
blocks.translation: You can also switch the character you control, allowing you to freely use the diverse cast of companions.

blocks.source: ただし、コマンド戦闘時代の要素も色濃く残っている。アクション式とコマンド式を組み合わせた結果、多少のクセはあるので最初はとまどうかも。
blocks.translation: However, elements from the command-battle era remain strongly present. The combination of action and command-based systems has some quirks, so you may be confused at first.

blocks.source: ＳＰを消費してスキルを使用するといった仕様はそのまま。シリーズ特有の属性相性の重要さも、相変わらずである。
blocks.translation: The system of consuming SP to use skills remains unchanged. The importance of elemental affinities, a series staple, also remains as strong as ever.

blocks.source: ターンや待ち時間のような仕組みが存在しないため、ほとんど隙間なくスキルを使えてしまう。アイテムに至っては在庫の許す限り使い放題になっている。
blocks.translation: Since there are no systems such as turns or cooldowns, you can use skills with almost no gaps between them. As for items, you can use them as freely as your inventory allows.

blocks.source: その結果、ペルソナのスキルで弱点攻撃を連発するなどの単純な戦法が強い。弱点をつくと敵は動きを止める傾向があるので、ＳＰが持つ限りは一方的に攻撃できてしまう。
blocks.translation: As a result, simple tactics such as repeatedly attacking weaknesses with Persona skills are powerful. Enemies tend to stop moving when you hit their weaknesses, so you can attack them unilaterally as long as you have SP.

blocks.source: その代わり、ＳＰの消耗もシビアなので、アイテムでの補給なしで大ボスを倒し切れるほどではない。その辺りを考慮してか、ＳＰの枯渇を前提にしてバランスを取っているように思えた。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, SP is also consumed severely, so it is not possible to defeat a major boss without replenishing it with items. Perhaps taking that into account, the game seems to be balanced on the assumption that your SP will run dry.

blocks.source: どうにかこうにかバランスを取っているけれど、色々と大味な印象も。
blocks.translation: It somehow manages to maintain its balance, but it also feels rather rough around the edges in various ways.

blocks.source: システム上、アイテムで回復している限りはそうそう全滅することはない。そのため、強敵と戦う場合は、泥沼の消耗戦となりやすい。
blocks.translation: Because of the system, you rarely suffer a total party wipe as long as you recover with items. As a result, battles against strong enemies tend to become grueling wars of attrition.

blocks.source: 強敵との戦いは『楽しい』というよりも『しんどい』というのが正直な感想だった。
blocks.translation: My honest impression was that battles against strong enemies were more “tough” than “fun.”

blocks.source: 難易度ノーマルでも最初のダンジョンのボスから結構強いししぶとい。実のところ、最初のボスが一番苦戦した。
blocks.translation: Even on Normal difficulty, the first dungeon boss is quite strong and tenacious. In fact, the first boss gave me the most trouble.

blocks.source: アクションが苦手なら素直に難易度を落とすのも手。難易度は途中からでも変更できる。
blocks.translation: If you are not good at action games, simply lowering the difficulty is an option. You can change the difficulty partway through.

blocks.source: サブクエスト
blocks.translation: Side Quests

blocks.source: サブクエストに当たる『リクエスト』は正直あまり面白くはない。基本的には一度クリアしたダンジョンに再度もぐって、特定の敵を倒すなどの作業をすることになる。
blocks.translation: The “Requests,” which serve as side quests, are honestly not very interesting. Basically, you revisit dungeons you have already cleared and perform tasks such as defeating specific enemies.

blocks.source: 本編でも思ったのだけど、アクセサリは複数装備できてもよかった気がする。サブイベントのボス戦で苦労してアクセサリを手に入れても、既に持っているものと代わり映えなくて、使い道のないことが多かった。
blocks.translation: I felt this way in the main game as well, but I think it would have been nice to equip multiple accessories. Even when you work hard to obtain an accessory from a side-event boss battle, it is often so similar to one you already have that it has no real use.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: ダンジョン進入時などのロード時間は若干気になるレベル。特にリクエストをこなす場合は、短時間で何度も出入りすることになるので気になる。
blocks.translation: The loading times when entering dungeons and the like are long enough to be somewhat noticeable. This is especially noticeable when completing Requests, since you repeatedly enter and leave in a short period of time.

blocks.source: メニュー画面にいちいち演出が入っていたりする辺り、「快適性よりも演出」という傾向があるのは否定できないかも。
blocks.translation: The fact that the menu screen includes elaborate effects every time also suggests a tendency toward “presentation over comfort,” which cannot be denied.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: 本編から色々と使い回しの省エネ仕様。
blocks.translation: Various elements are reused from the main game as a cost-saving measure.

blocks.source: とはいえ、無双系特有の戦闘演出は新鮮だった。
blocks.translation: That said, the battle presentation unique to musou-style games felt fresh.

blocks.source: 各ダンジョンのボスは皆個性的で、見ていて面白いものが多かった。
blocks.translation: The bosses in each dungeon were all distinctive, and many were interesting to watch.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 相変わらずのペルソナ５。
blocks.translation: Persona 5 as usual.

blocks.source: 使い回しも多いけれど質は高いというか、いつも通りといったところ。
blocks.translation: A lot of it is reused, but the quality is high—or rather, it's just as good as ever.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Impression

blocks.source: 戦闘面に多少のクセはあるけれど、ストーリー面は安心のペルソナ。
blocks.translation: The battles have some quirks, but the story is the reassuringly solid Persona we've come to expect.

blocks.source: アクションが嫌いでなければ、ペルソナ５が好きだった人には安心してオススメできるかなと。
blocks.translation: As long as you don't dislike action games, I can comfortably recommend it to anyone who enjoyed Persona 5.
